original_pdf_quote_en: OrionDesk AI takes a case and permitted evidence through ingestion, retrieval, model generation and a deterministic publication gate.
The browser never sends arbitrary tool definitions to the orchestrator.
Approval is bound to the reviewed artifact hash, and every cited answer can be traced to immutable source versions.
Untrusted retrieved documents and LLM responses cannot authorize tools, change tenant scope, alter approvals or bypass the versioned deterministic policy engine.
Primary deployment profile: stateless HTTP APIs
PostgreSQL transactional store
private blob/object storage
hybrid vector and keyword search
event queue with a transactional outbox
managed-identity credentials
a scoped LLM gateway
and explicit human-review routes.
NORMATIVE INVARIANT All revised invariants must be linked to at least one negative test.

All identities, cases, documents and provider replies in this specification are synthetic.
Fixtures cover successful, empty, mixed-permission, adversarial and malformed inputs.
Every randomized test records its seed.
Evaluation corpora are frozen, versioned and independently reviewed for leakage between training examples and acceptance data.

The deployment pipeline runs unit tests, schema evolution tests, negative authorization tests, workflow replay tests, staging connector sync, visual accessibility checks, search recall benchmarks, grounding evaluations, policy-recall evaluations, load tests and disaster recovery drills.
Test outputs are signed and referenced by release digest.
Detect Alert on queue oldest age and index backlog; find affected tenant and index generation.
Contain Pause only the faulty connector or indexer shard; keep accepted source records durable.
Diagnose Inspect event ID, outbox lag, parser flags, search throttling and source ACL revision.
Recover Replay validated outbox records using a bounded operator-controlled job.
Verify Compare source fingerprints to indexed versions, run denied-access probes and close incident.
Document Link audit IDs, time window, blast radius, quality effect and preventative action.

Before implementation lock, select the supported cloud region, exact search provider, identity provider, approved model deployments, corporate retention policy and third-party connector permissions. Each selection must be recorded in a dated architecture decision rather than silently presumed by this synthetic baseline.
